subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “As buildings change and machines disappear, sounds vanish too.”?
options: A sound can be noise to one person and memory to another.
It also teaches students to notice good things before they disappear from memory.
A minute cannot finish everything, but it can open the door.
Recording them can preserve a layer of memory that photos cannot capture.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「A sound can be noise to one person and memory to another.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It also teaches students to notice good things before they disappear from memory.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A minute cannot finish everything, but it can open the door.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「As buildings change and machines disappear, sounds vanish too. Recording them can preserve a layer of memory that photos cannot capture.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「As buildings change and machines disappear, sounds vanish too. Recording them can preserve a layer of memory that photos cannot capture.」，答案為「Recording them can preserve a layer of memory that photos cannot capture.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Recording them can preserve a layer of memory that photos cannot capture.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
